approach.api: nx.simple_cycles(G, length_bound=None, *, min_length=0), inclusive lower bound; validate negative bounds and return no cycles for empty intervals.
approach.short_cycles: Skip self-loops and undirected parallel-edge 2-cycle emission when outside the lower bound. Keep node-sequence multigraph semantics.
approach.search_pruning: Only enter/re-enter directed SCCs or undirected BCCs with at least min_length nodes. For directed min_length > 3, first decompose the underlying undirected graph into BCCs and search only qualifying blocks, using independent copies to retain non-mutation and avoid modifying a live block traversal.
approach.proof: A directed simple cycle on at least three distinct nodes is an undirected simple cycle after forgetting arc direction. Every such cycle lies in one biconnected block, so skipping smaller blocks cannot discard an eligible cycle. Distinct blocks share at most articulation vertices and cannot duplicate these cycles.
approach.bookkeeping: Inside retained components, gate emission only. Preserve Johnson closed/unblocking and Gupta-Suzumura blen/lock relaxation even on short closures.
approach.limits: No general complexity improvement claimed. Within retained blocks, suppression alone does not avoid searching short cycles. Component pruning does avoid search, demonstrated by instrumented regressions; prescribed speedup thresholds are unevaluated in this development run.
